title: Ambient Light
description: Any color on the interior ambient light. Your car's zones in a list (the ones your car has): give each the main color, its own or the car's, or pick All zones. Color bars for any shade, brightness (or follow the car's), the car's nine colors, and six presets that keep the whole look. Drive modes: a color for each drive mode (Sport, Comfort, Eco Pro, their Plus and Individual, Adaptive) that the light switches to with the mode, on or off. Works while the car's own ambient light is on. Needs the Comfort tool from the same source. Works with the touchscreen or the iDrive controller. iDrive 7 and
